tagline: Leading global coal producer with diversified seaborne and U.S. thermal operations
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of Peabody's performance, directly reflecting the value generated from each ton of coal sold. It is essential for understanding operational profitability in a volatile commodity market.

kpis.name: Revenue per Ton
kpis.explanation: Average amount of revenue generated from the sale of one ton of coal.
kpis.description: Measures the company's ability to monetize its products across different market segments.

kpis.name: Costs per Ton
kpis.explanation: Average cost incurred to produce and sell one ton of coal.
kpis.description: Indicates direct expenses related to coal extraction and preparation.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin per Ton
kpis.explanation: Operating margin before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, adjusted per ton of coal sold.
kpis.description: Key indicator of mining operations profitability.

kpis.name: Proven and Probable Coal Reserves
kpis.explanation: Total estimated quantity of coal that can be economically extracted from known deposits as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: Represents the quantity of coal available for future extraction.
kpis.signal: Long-term resource base for future operations.

kpis.name: Coal Resources
kpis.explanation: Total estimated quantity of coal in the ground beyond proven and probable reserves.
kpis.description: Indicates potential to increase proven and probable reserves.

kpis.name: Tons Sold
kpis.explanation: Total volume of coal sold by the company during the period.
kpis.description: Measures the quantity of coal marketed by the company.

kpis.name: Seaborne EBITDA Contribution
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total adjusted EBITDA from seaborne mining operations (Thermal and Metallurgical).
kpis.description: Indicates the importance of export activities in overall profitability.

kpis.name: US Operations EBITDA Contribution
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total adjusted EBITDA from domestic U.S. mining operations (PRB and Other U.S. Thermal).
kpis.description: Indicates the importance of domestic activities in overall profitability.

kpis.name: Middlemount Metallurgical Coal Sales
kpis.explanation: Volume of metallurgical coal sold from the Middlemount Mine (50% equity stake).
kpis.description: Tracking sales from an important asset in the metallurgical coal segment.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to increased competition in the coal market, which could impact its sales and prices.

risks.title: Regulation and Environmental Policy
risks.score_rationale: Changes in government policies and environmental regulations could impact the company's operations.

risks.title: Geopolitics and Trade Policy
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions and changes in trade policies could impact the company's coal exports, particularly concerning tariffs and customs regulations.

risks.title: Environmental and Climate Factors
risks.score_rationale: The company's operations could be impacted by environmental factors such as climate change and natural disasters.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to potential litigation related to its operations and relationships with stakeholders.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation could be impacted by environmental incidents and litigation.

ai_positioning.summary: The company BTU does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies in its 10-K filing.
